title: ADL Agent
description: Declarative definition of one agent in the AI company. Runtime-agnostic; a compiler backend maps it to a concrete runtime (e.g. Claude Code).

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. Must match the spec filename.

department.description: Owning department (office). 'company' = meta-level orchestration (ceo, scaffolder) — distinct from the 'cross-cutting' business office (security, legal).

tier.description: Org role. ceo/head run as their own bot; specialists are Task-tool subagents.

description.description: One-paragraph role summary. Emitted verbatim as the runtime agent description.

model.description: Logical model tier. The compiler backend resolves it to a concrete model id.

surface.description: bot = has its own Discord identity (needs tokenEnv); subagent = invoked via the Task tool.

tokenEnv.description: Env var holding this bot's Discord token. Required for bots, forbidden for subagents (enforced by validate.mjs).

default.description: True for the single bot that fields un-mentioned messages (the CEO).

tools.description: Runtime tools this agent may call.

skills.description: Skill playbooks this agent is expected to invoke.

mcp.description: MCP servers this agent relies on (informational; must exist in .mcp.json).

canMention.description: Peer agent names this agent is allowed to @mention (hand-off contract).

handoffVia.description: Primary durable hand-off channel for cross-department work.

draftsOnly.description: True if the agent must never ship/send/deploy — output goes to a draft or PR.

inherits.description: Named shared rule sets this agent inherits (e.g. company-hard-rules).

body.description: Path (relative to adl/) to the Markdown system-prompt body for this agent.
